vsm2.17:19.2:
Paccayatā aññoññaṃ, paṭicca yasmā samaṃ saha ca dhamme;
Ayamuppādeti tatopi, evamidha bhāsitā muninā.
vsm2.17:20.1: Avijjādisīsena niddiṭṭhapaccayesu hi ye paccayā yaṃ saṅkhārādikaṃ dhammaṃ uppādenti,
vsm2.17:20.2: na te aññamaññaṃ apaṭicca aññamaññavekalle sati uppādetuṃ samatthāti.
vsm2.17:20.3: Tasmā paṭicca samaṃ saha ca na ekekadesaṃ, nāpi pubbāparabhāvena ayaṃ paccayatā dhamme uppādetīti
vsm2.17:20.4: atthānusāravohārakusalena muninā evamidha bhāsitā, paṭiccasamuppādotveva bhāsitāti attho.
vsm2.17:21.5: Kiṃ hi sassatānaṃ, ahetuādivasena vā pavattānaṃ paccayasāmaggiyāti?
vsm2.17:23.1: Pacchimena ca padenāti dhammānaṃ uppādaparidīpakena samuppādapadena
vsm2.17:24.1: Dvayenāti sakalena paṭiccasamuppādavacanena tassā tassā paccayasāmaggiyā santatiṃ avicchinditvā tesaṃ tesaṃ dhammānaṃ sambhavato majjhimā paṭipadā,
vsm2.17:24.2: ‘‘so karoti so paṭisaṃvedeti, añño karoti añño paṭisaṃvedetī’’ti vādappahānaṃ,
vsm2.17:24.3: janapadaniruttiyā anabhiniveso, samaññāya anatidhāvananti ayaṃ ñāyo paridīpito hoti
vsm2.17:24.4: iti ayaṃ tāva paṭiccasamuppādoti vacanamattassa attho.
vsm2.17:25.1: 581. Yā panāyaṃ bhagavatā paṭiccasamuppādaṃ desentena ‘‘avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā’’tiādinā nayena nikkhittā tanti,
vsm2.17:25.2: tassā atthasaṃvaṇṇanaṃ karontena vibhajjavādimaṇḍalaṃ otaritvā ācariye anabbhācikkhantena sakasamayaṃ avokkamantena
vsm2.17:25.3: parasamayaṃ anāyūhantena suttaṃ appaṭibāhantena vinayaṃ anulomentena mahāpadese olokentena
vsm2.17:25.4: dhammaṃ dīpentena atthaṃ saṅgāhentena tamevatthaṃ punarāvattetvā aparehipi pariyāyantarehi niddisantena ca yasmā atthasaṃvaṇṇanā kātabbā hoti,
vsm2.17:25.7:
‘‘Saccaṃ satto paṭisandhi, paccayākārameva ca;
Duddasā caturo dhammā, desetuṃ ca sudukkarā’’ti.
vsm2.17:25.8: Tasmā aññatra āgamādhigamappattehi na sukarā paṭiccasamuppādassatthavaṇṇanāti paritulayitvā,
vsm2.17:25.9:
Vattukāmo ahaṃ ajja, paccayākāravaṇṇanaṃ;
Patiṭṭhaṃ nādhigacchāmi, ajjhogāḷhova sāgaraṃ.
vsm2.17:25.10:
Sāsanaṃ panidaṃ nānā, desanānayamaṇḍitaṃ;
Pubbācariyamaggo ca, abbocchinno pavattati.
vsm2.17:25.11:
Yasmā tasmā tadubhayaṃ, sannissāyatthavaṇṇanaṃ;
Ārabhissāmi etassa, taṃ suṇātha samāhitā.
vsm2.17:26.2:
‘‘Yo koci maṃ aṭṭhikatvā suṇeyya,
Labhetha pubbāpariyaṃ visesaṃ;
Laddhāna pubbāpariyaṃ visesaṃ,
Adassanaṃ maccurājassa gacche’’ti.
vsm2.17:27.1: 582. Iti avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārātiādīsu hi āditoyeva tāva,
vsm2.17:27.2: Desanābhedato attha, lakkhaṇekavidhādito. Aṅgānañca vavatthānā, viññātabbo vinicchayo.
vsm2.17:28.1: Tattha desanābhedatoti bhagavato hi vallihārakānaṃ catunnaṃ purisānaṃ valligahaṇaṃ viya ādito vā majjhato vā paṭṭhāya yāva pariyosānaṃ,
vsm2.17:28.2: tathā pariyosānato vā majjhato vā paṭṭhāya yāva ādīti catubbidhā paṭiccasamuppādadesanā.
vsm2.17:29.1: Yathā hi vallihārakesu catūsu purisesu eko valliyā mūlameva paṭhamaṃ passati, so taṃ mūle chetvā sabbaṃ ākaḍḍhitvā ādāya kamme upaneti,
vsm2.17:29.2: evaṃ bhagavā ‘‘iti kho, bhikkhave, avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā…pe… jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇa’’nti (ma. ni. 1.402; saṃ. ni. 2.2) ādito paṭṭhāya yāva pariyosānāpi paṭiccasamuppādaṃ deseti.
vsm2.17:30.1: Yathā pana tesu purisesu eko valliyā majjhaṃ paṭhamaṃ passati, so majjhe chinditvā uparibhāgaññeva ākaḍḍhitvā ādāya kamme upaneti,
vsm2.17:30.2: evaṃ bhagavā ‘‘tassa taṃ vedanaṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandī.
vsm2.17:30.3: Yā vedanāsu nandī, tadupādānaṃ. Tassupādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jātī’’ti (ma. ni. 1.409; saṃ. ni. 3.5) majjhato paṭṭhāya yāva pariyosānāpi deseti.
vsm2.17:31.1: Yathā ca tesu purisesu eko valliyā aggaṃ paṭhamaṃ passati, so agge gahetvā aggānusārena yāva mūlā sabbaṃ ādāya kamme upaneti,
vsm2.17:31.2: evaṃ bhagavā ‘‘jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇanti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ, jātipaccayā nu kho, bhikkhave, jarāmaraṇaṃ no vā kathaṃ vo ettha hotīti?
vsm2.17:31.3: Jātipaccayā, bhante, jarāmaraṇaṃ. Evaṃ no ettha hoti jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇanti.
vsm2.17:31.4: Bhavapaccayā jāti…pe… avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārāti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ, avijjāpaccayā nu kho, bhikkhave, saṅkhārā no vā kathaṃ vo ettha hotī’’ti (ma. ni. 1.403) pariyosānato paṭṭhāya yāva āditopi paṭiccasamuppādaṃ deseti.
vsm2.17:32.1: Yathā panetesu purisesu eko valliyā majjhameva paṭhamaṃ passati, so majjhe chinditvā heṭṭhā otaranto yāva mūlā ādāya kamme upaneti,
vsm2.17:32.2: evaṃ bhagavā ‘‘ime ca, bhikkhave, cattāro āhārā kinnidānā, kiṃsamudayā, kiṃjātikā, kiṃpabhavā?
vsm2.17:32.3: Ime cattāro āhārā taṇhānidānā, taṇhāsamudayā, taṇhājātikā, taṇhāpabhavā.
vsm2.17:32.4: Taṇhā kinnidānā… vedanā… phasso… saḷāyatanaṃ… nāmarūpaṃ… viññāṇaṃ… saṅkhārā kinnidānā…pe… saṅkhārā avijjānidānā…pe… avijjāpabhavā’’ti (saṃ. ni. 2.11) majjhato paṭṭhāya yāva ādito deseti.
vsm2.17:33.3: Samantabhaddako hi paṭiccasamuppādo, tato tato ñāyapaṭivedhāya saṃvattatiyeva.
vsm2.17:33.4: Desanāvilāsappatto ca bhagavā catuvesārajjapaṭisambhidāyogena catubbidhagambhīrabhāvappattiyā ca.
vsm2.17:34.1: Visesato panassa yā ādito paṭṭhāya anulomadesanā,
vsm2.17:34.2: sā pavattikāraṇavibhāgasaṃmūḷhaṃ veneyyajanaṃ samanupassato yathāsakehi kāraṇehi pavattisandassanatthaṃ
vsm2.17:34.4: Yā pana majjhato paṭṭhāya yāva pariyosānaṃ pavattā,
vsm2.17:34.5: sā paccuppanne addhāne anāgataddhahetusamuṭṭhānato pabhuti anāgataddhasandassanatthaṃ.
vsm2.17:34.6: Yā pariyosānato paṭṭhāya paṭilomadesanā, sā ‘‘kicchaṃ vatāyaṃ loko āpanno jāyati ca jīyati ca mīyati ca cavati ca upapajjati cā’’tiādinā (dī. ni. 2.57; saṃ. ni. 2.4) nayena kicchāpannaṃ lokaṃ anuvilokayato
vsm2.17:34.7: pubbabhāgapaṭivedhānusārena tassa tassa jarāmaraṇādikassa dukkhassa attanā adhigatakāraṇasandassanatthaṃ.
vsm2.17:34.8: Yā majjhato paṭṭhāya yāva ādi pavattā, sā āhāranidānavavatthāpanānusārena yāva atītaṃ addhānaṃ atiharitvā
vsm2.17:35.1: Tāsu yā pavattikāraṇasammūḷhassa veneyyajanassa yathāsakehi kāraṇehi pavattisandassanatthaṃ
vsm2.17:35.2: uppattikkamasandassanatthañca ādito paṭṭhāya anulomadesanā vuttā, sā idha nikkhittāti veditabbā.
vsm2.17:36.2: kiṃ pakativādīnaṃ pakati viya avijjāpi akāraṇaṃ mūlakāraṇaṃ lokassāti?
vsm2.17:36.4: ‘‘Āsavasamudayā avijjāsamudayo’’ti (ma. ni. 1.103) hi avijjāya kāraṇaṃ vuttaṃ.
vsm2.17:36.5: Atthi pana pariyāyo yena mūlakāraṇaṃ siyā, ko pana soti?
vsm2.17:37.1: Bhagavā hi vaṭṭakathaṃ kathento dve dhamme sīsaṃ katvā katheti, avijjaṃ vā.
vsm2.17:37.2: Yathāha – ‘‘purimā, bhikkhave, koṭi na paññāyati avijjāya ‘ito pubbe avijjā nāhosi, atha pacchā samabhavī’ti,
vsm2.17:37.3: evañcetaṃ, bhikkhave, vuccati, atha ca pana paññāyati idappaccayā avijjā’’ti (a. ni. 10.61);
vsm2.17:37.5: Yathāha – ‘‘purimā, bhikkhave, koṭi na paññāyati bhavataṇhāya ‘ito pubbe bhavataṇhā nāhosi, atha pacchā samabhavī’ti,
vsm2.17:37.6: evañcetaṃ, bhikkhave, vuccati, atha ca pana paññāyati idappaccayā bhavataṇhā’’ti (a. ni. 10.62).
vsm2.17:38.1: 585. Kasmā pana bhagavā vaṭṭakathaṃ kathento ime dve dhamme sīsaṃ katvā kathetīti?
vsm2.17:39.3: Yasmā avijjābhibhūto puthujjano aggisantāpalaguḷābhighātaparissamābhibhūtā vajjhagāvī tāya parissamāturatāya nirassādampi attano anatthāvahampi ca uṇhodakapānaṃ viya
vsm2.17:39.4: kilesasantāpato nirassādampi duggatinipātanato ca attano anatthāvahampi pāṇātipātādiṃ anekappakāraṃ duggatigāmikammaṃ ārabhati.
vsm2.17:40.3: Yasmā bhavataṇhābhibhūto puthujjano sā vuttappakārā gāvī sītūdakataṇhāya saassādaṃ attano parissamavinodanañca sītūdakapānaṃ viya
vsm2.17:40.4: kilesasantāpavirahato saassādaṃ sugatisampāpanena attano duggatidukkhaparissamavinodanañca pāṇātipātā veramaṇiādiṃ anekappakāraṃ sugatigāmikammaṃ ārabhati.
